name: Loops
description: Work with Loops without leaving Claude. Manage contacts and mailing lists, send transactional emails, work with events, and access everything else available through the Loops API. Just tell Claude what you want to do.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Loops to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Loops to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.loops.so/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Loops MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Loops provides these MCP tools: describe, execute, search, and teams.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Loops?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Loops in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.
Loops requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Loops is developed by Loops. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
